title: Walks in the quadrant with interacting boundaries : genus zero case
summary: The study of lattice walks restricted to the first quadrant has shed a lot of interest in the past twenty years. In particular, there has been an important effort to classify models of weighted walks with small steps with respect to the algebraic-differential nature of their generating function. The techniques that were developed in the course of this work are now applied to different extensions of those walks.
